glossary.note: 钢铁雄心4 术语对照表。翻译时严格遵守，保证全站译名一致。

style.register: 游戏指南体，简体中文，简洁直陈，不用敬语，不用『您』。
style.numbers: 数字、百分比、游戏内数值原样保留（如 10%、+5%）。
style.placeholders: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ 等占位符必须原样保留且不得增删、不得调换顺序；它们代表图标或链接。
style.markup: 不要输出 HTML 标签；保留原文的换行与项目符号结构。
style.properNouns: 国家、人物、舰名等专有名词使用通用中文译名（如 German Reich → 德意志国，Adolf Hitler → 阿道夫·希特勒）；Paradox 未汉化的专有名词可保留英文并加中文注释。
style.consistency: 同一英文术语在全站必须使用同一译名。

units.en: Greece will become an absolute monarchy and seek to join the Allies.
Join the Central Powers
Greece will become an absolute monarchy and seek to join the Central Powers with Germany or Austria-Hungary.
Stalinist
Greece will attempt to join the Comintern and spark a battle for the Bosporus with Turkey.
Greece will attempt to fight fascism in Europe alongside communist Yugoslavia.
Venezelist
Greece will fight for the right to fulfill the Megali Idea.
Greece will become a National Socialist republic and attempt to join the Axis alongside Turkey.
Anatolian Fascist
Greece will become democratic, suffer a collapse in government, and then go on to aspire for the grandest of ambitions...
Bulgaria

Tsar Boris III will lead the country towards the Axis, relying on German arbitration to expand Bulgarian borders peacefully, eventually signing the Tripartite Pact and delaying Bulgarian participation in the war.
Bulgaria will attempt to join the Comintern and fight together with its Soviet comrades against fascism and capitalism in Europe.
Communist - Balkan Federation
Bulgaria will attempt to form a Balkan alliance, influencing its neighbors to embrace the revolution and ultimately unifying the Balkans.
As fascism rises in the country, right-wing leader Hristo Lukov will attempt to join the Axis, eventually overthrowing the Tsar and imposing a military dictatorship.
The Return of Ferdinand I
Following the death of Tsar Boris III, his father Ferdinand I will sit on the throne once again, seeking revenge against those who wronged him decades ago.
Democratic - Socialist

The government led by Nikola Mushanov will follow socialist policies, seeking to improve its relations with neighboring nations to form a Balkan Confederation and defend the Balkans against foreign aggressors.
Democratic - Liberal
The Bulgarian Democratic Party will attempt to join the Allies as it conspires against Tsar Boris to remove him from power and form a pro-Allies regency council.
Turkey
Turkey will pursue neutrality for as long as possible under the leadership of İsmet Inönü, and then attempt to join the Allies.
Alternative Kemalist

Turkey will appoint Fevzi Çakmak to follow in Mustafa Kemal Atatürk’s footsteps as President, and will pursue neutrality for as long as possible before attempting to join either the Axis or the Allies.
Democratic Kemalism
Celâl Bayar will transition Turkey into a Kemalist democracy and attempt to join the Allies.
Democratic Conservatism
Adnan Menderes will transition Turkey into a conservative democracy and attempt to join the Allies.
Kemalist Fascism
Recep Peker shall transition Turkey into a fascist dictatorship and attempt to join the Axis.
Militaristic Fascism
Fevzi Çakmak shall transition Turkey into a conservative quasi-fascist dictatorship and attempt to form a faction with Italy.
Communism
Turkey will install a communist government and attempt to join the Comintern.
Turkey will adopt a communist government that maintains its Kemalist qualities and attempt to form a faction of its own.
Safeguard the Balkans
Turkey will commit itself to maintaining security in the Balkans and attempt to form a faction with Greece, Romania, and Yugoslavia.
Restore the Ottoman Sultanate
The Republic of Turkey will collapse and from its ashes the Ottoman Sultanate shall be restored to power once again.
Lithuania
The Lithuanian AI will remain neutral for most of the campaign but will become a Soviet puppet in the 1940s.
Lithuania will attempt to formalize the Baltic Entente and survive against the Soviets.
The Lithuanian AI will attempt to establish a fascist government by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
The AI will attempt to establish a communist regime by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
Lithuania will attempt to restore the monarchy and claim the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth.
Latvia
The Latvian AI will remain neutral for most of the campaign but will become a Soviet puppet in the 1940s.
Latvia will attempt to formalize the Baltic Entente and survive against the Soviets.
The Latvian AI will attempt to establish a fascist government by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
Estonia
The Estonian AI will remain neutral for most of the campaign but will become a Soviet puppet in the 1940s.
Estonia will attempt to formalize the Baltic Entente and survive against the Soviets.
The Estonian AI will attempt to establish a fascist government by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
Ethiopia
The Ethiopian AI will attempt to defeat Italy using the Legaue of nations ⟦0⟧, and if that fails try to go into exile. Thereafter it will try to recover its home territory, and rebuild Ethiopia.
sic
Imperial: The Lion Stands Firm
The Ethiopian AI will attempt to defeat Italy on its own, without getting the help of the League of Nations. Thereafter it will attempt to expand its empire.
Communist: Soviet Aid
The AI will attempt to turn Ethiopia communist and garner the support of the Soviet Union, turning it into a Stalinist puppet.
Anarcho-Communist: Callout to the World
The AI will attempt to turn Ethiopia into an anarcho-communist federation with the support of communists and anarchists from across the world.
Fascist: Collaborationist
The AI will stab Haile Selassie in the back and side with the Italians, causing Ethiopia to become a fascist puppet.
Fascist: Independent
The AI will stab Haile Selassie in the back and side with the Italians, causing Ethiopia to become a fascist puppet. However, it will attempt to break free and become an independent fascist nation.
Switzerland
Switzerland will remain neutral, while building up their militias and fortifications in preparation for any attack. They will give some support to the allies towards the end of the war.
Allied Democratic
The AI will arm Switzerland and prepare for war, aligning Switzerland to the democratic powers of the world, eventually breaking neutrality in favor of the Allies
Expansionist Democracy
The AI will will try to convince states around Switzerland to join the confederation, and will arm the country in preparation for owner of those states refusing to let their states be free.
Imperial
The AI will attempt to form the Alpine Protectorate by abandoning neutrality and democracy in favor of a militaristic and expansionist regime.
The AI will make Switzerland align itself with Germany and slowly turn the country fascist, eventually either allying with the Axis or becoming a German Puppet.
Sweden

The AI will attempt to build up the Swedish military while remaining neutral and democratic. It will carefully avoid getting into conflict with the Axis and Comintern, but may offer limited support to the Allies later in the war.
Alternative Democratic
The Swedish AI will go down the democratic tree but will be more likely to become actively involved in the war by rearming faster, leaning more into right-leaning policies.
Nordic Defence Council
The AI will try and form the Nordic Defence Council to protect the Nordics
The Swedish AI will go down the communist tree and either ally the Axis or the Allies
Independent Fascist
The Swedish AI will go down the fascist path, remain independent and try to form the Great Nordic Kingdom
Obedient Reichskommissariat Fascist
The Swedish AI will go down the fascist path, become subservient to Germany and remain obedient to their overlord.
Backstabber Reichskommissariat Fascist
The Swedish AI will go down the fascist path, become subservient to Germany and break free from them when the time is right.
The Swedish AI will go down the unaligned path, return the king to power and try to form the Great Nordic Kingdom
Norway
Norway will attempt to remain democratic and resist the German invasion before continuing to fight on as a government in exile, alongside the Allies.
The AI will attempt to increase the popularity of Communism, while aligning Norway to Stalin's Soviet Union, or the biggest Non-Trostkyist Communist country if Stalin has been ousted.
Trotskyist
The AI will try to keep Lev Trotskij in Norway, and follow his principles of Communism, going against the Soviet Union if it remains Stalinist, and allying with it if Trotskij becomes its leader.
Nasjonal Samling
The AI will let Fascism's influence grow over time, and will eventually align with The Third Reich, or go it alone if Germany is no longer Fascist.
The AI will start pressuring King Haakon VII to dismantle the Storting and turn Norway into an Oligarchic Monarchy.
Finland
The Finnish AI will attempt to follow the historical chain of events as much as possible.

The Finnish Right, led by the Patriotic People's Movement, will overthrow the former conservative democracy, attempting to strengthen ties with Germany and relying on organizations like the Mustapaidat and Suojeluskunta to develop a powerful military and expand the country's borders according to the Greater Finland idea.

Seeking help from the Soviet Union, communists will organize the Finnish left movement, uniting socialists, social-democrats and other left-wing elements in order to coup the government and lead the country towards a new revolution against the capitalist and fascist threats abroad.

Finnish Social-Democrats will appeal to the Finnish people and lead a drastic but bloodless change in the course of Finnish politics. Finland will then attempt to join other western major democracies in order to preserve the country's sovereignty and its conservative-left society.
Denmark

The Danish AI will attempt to stay out of any conflicts and follow the historical events as much as possible. If it becomes a subject, it will try to slowly build support with foreign powers to eventually reassert its independence once again.
Danish Rearmament
Denmark will try to seek alliances with stronger nations and try to withstand any invasion attempts.
Expansionist Monarchy
King Christian X will try to secure natural resources and strengthen Denmark's military capabilities by controlling the rest of the Nordics by any means necessary.
Fascist Denmark
The Fascist Party will try to seize power in Denmark and re-establish the North Sea Empire of old.
Iceland
The Icelandic AI will try to maintain neutrality and will seek US protection when needed.
Supporting Denmark
The Icelandic AI will attempt to support a Danish defense against any attacker
The Icelandic AI will denounce the Danish King, and try to create a fascist empire in the North Sea
The Icelandic AI will denounce the monarchy, and establish a communist state in Iceland.
Chile
The Chilean AI will reinforce the democratic system and choose to support social-democratic policies whilst maintaining the power balance, and will join the global struggle only if it drags on.
The Socialist Republic of Chile
The Chilean AI will utilize the instability caused by the fascist to demands Arturo Alessandri's resignation, and increase presidential powers so that they can instate a communist state.
Cooperation with Operation Bolivar
The Chilean AI will go down the path of fascism, choosing to side with the German Reich if they get the chance, eventually going to war and attempting to restore the Kingdom of Chile of old.
Pan-Hispanism

The Chilean AI will go down the path of fascism, eventually choosing to not side with any of the great world powers. They will later go on to either conquer the Hispanic world, or unite it diplomatically.
Anti-Imperialism

The Chilean AI will choose to support the various Mapuche organizations, eventually having them take control of the country. It will later go on a crusade against Imperialism, outing the European controlled states from South and Central America.
The Kingdom of Araucanía and Patagonia

The Chilean AI will look to tradition and thus oust Alessandri from power, instating Ibáñez in his place. It will then go into a civil war, in which Antoine III will restore the old Kingdom of Araucanía and Patagonia, declaring himself a successor to Napoleon.
Brazil
Vargas will attempt to stay in power by carefully eliminating the political opposition in Brazil before eventually joining the Allies and working with the United States.
Fascism
The Integralist movement will betray Vargas and install one of their own as leader. They will then attempt to dominate South America through diplomacy and force.

Brazil will attempt to overthrow Vargas by ending the state of emergency. It will then attempt to reform the nation, increasing democratic participation before ultimately cooperating with the USA against the Axis powers.
Monarchist - Dom Pedro Henrique
The AI will attempt to reform the Empire of Brazil by gaining support for Pedro Henrique as the rightful heir to the throne. It will then attempt to conquer or integrate Brazil's neighbors.
Monarchist - Dom Pedro de Alcântara

The AI will attempt to reform the Empire of Brazil by gaining support for Pedro de Alcântara as the rightful heir to the throne. It will then attempt to reunify with Portugal through diplomacy or force.
Communism - Luís Carlos Prestes

Brazil will attempt to overthrow the democratic government and replace it with a Soviet aligned, communist government headed by Luís Carlos Prestes. It will then join the Comintern and aide the Soviet Union.
Communism - Aliança Nacional Libertadora

Brazil will resurrect the ANL and attempt to overthrow the democratic government. It will be replaced by the ANL council who will then implement communist reforms before ultimately attempting to liberate the continent from fascism and imperialism.
Argentina
The AI will attempt to adhere to historical events by avoiding entry into the war and gradually cooperating with the UK and USA.
The AI will attempt to turn the country fascist and will join the Axis powers to open up a new front in South America.
The AI will attempt to turn the country communist and will join the Comintern to focus on spreading their ideology in South America.
The AI will attempt to turn democratic and will join the Allies to safe guard democracy and freedom in South America.
Uruguay
The AI will attempt to keep out of world affairs and focus on internal industrialization, putting the Colorado party in power. Only joining the allies at the end of the war.
Alt Democratic
The AI will attempt to keep out of world affairs and focus on internal industrialization, putting the Blanco party in power. Only joining the allies at the end of the war.
The AI will align with the Axis, turning the country into a springboard for a South American conquest.
Paraguay
The AI will keep out of global politics and focus on internal issues, going through instabilities keeping it out of the war.
The AI will keep Rafael Franco's communist government and seek to take revenge against Bolivia for the Chaco War.
The AI will fight against Rafael Franco's coup and enter a civil war to try and keep its democratic government intact.
Austria
The AI will turn fascist and attempt to stave off the Anschluss with the Vaterländische Front at the helm.
Monarchist - Subjugation
